I am old now, 77 years, and my small piece of land is only rented. I will try to get the FISP coupon like before for a little NPK and urea, because without it I cannot afford fertilizer at full price. I plant hybrid maize when the coupon brings the seed, and I mix in pumpkins and beans between the maize rows. My sons and grandchildren help me with the hoe because I cannot dig all day anymore, and I have no money to hire people or to buy pesticide, and there is no irrigation here — we wait for the rains.
